# Upstream provenance

- Project: `@ybouane/liquidglass`
- Repository: https://github.com/ybouane/liquidglass
- Demo and documentation: https://liquid-glass.ybouane.com
- Published package version: `1.0.3`
- Published package Git commit: `2c8ff3de131fbd29e34ce389979f8d025a61c1a9`
- Package license declaration: `MIT`
- npm tarball SHA-1: `347752d90b4d637d384bfe400fa7df4ec0ebc094`
- Vendored `dist/index.js` SHA-256: `9630e5af0e9c27c3a88a2c4a7096a4f5e0f12e92afc6333f1552835dcc399bed`

The vendored `dist/index.js`, type declaration, README, and package metadata are
copied from the official npm package `@ybouane/liquidglass@1.0.3`. The upstream
repository and published package did not contain a standalone LICENSE file at
the pinned versions above, so the package's own MIT declaration is retained in
`package.json` and recorded here rather than inventing missing copyright text.

The runtime bundle, source map, and type declaration are stored byte-for-byte
as published. Project-specific React code configures the documented API but does
not patch or fork Ybouane's renderer or shaders.
